lines.en: I walk slowly, and the light follows me.
Each step, the ground glows briefly.
I walk head low, sniffing the roots.

lines.zh: 身上那层光，怎么都熄不了。
lines.en: This glow won't go out, no matter what.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，雾会散一点。
lines.en: The fog thins a little where I pass.
I head toward the brighter way.
I go round the stone and shift on.

lines.zh: 这里太暗了，我不太舒服。
lines.en: It's too dark here. Uncomfortable.
I lift a foot and set it down firm.
The wind opens a path in the fog.

lines.zh: 我从一片空地走到另一片。
lines.en: I move from one clearing to another.
My horns lead the way. Heavy.
Not fast, and no missteps.
I go toward the smell of water.
My light drags a line on the ground.
After I've gone, the line remains.
I stand, and the light on me wavers.
So quiet. I'm a little sleepy.
I shake the light off my hide.
Things in the fog won't come near.
I chew the grass slowly.
I can't control this brightness.
I lower my head to look at my feet.
The grass glows beside my hooves.

lines.zh: 我打了个喷嚏，光闪了一下。
lines.en: I sneeze and the light flashes.
I raise my horns and push upward.
The fog here is thinner than elsewhere.

lines.zh: 背上的光一明一暗，像在呼吸。
lines.en: The glow on my back pulses like breathing.
The light turns too.
I'm fine staying here.
The fog hasn't lifted. No hurry to move.
Until the fog thins more.
You're standing in front of me.
My light has found you.
I eat grass. You needn't be afraid.
I eat only grass. Nothing else.
I don't chase things.
You're too close. I can't see clearly.

lines.zh: 我往雾里缩了缩，盯着你。
lines.en: I shrink into the fog and watch you.
That's better.
You're very dark.

lines.zh: 我把光往你那边挪了一点。
lines.en: I shift my light toward you a little.
Now you can see the way.
There's light. Go on, slowly.
The light wavered and dimmed.

lines.zh: 光暗了一下，我又亮起来。
lines.en: My glow dips, then returns.
I don't take hits well.
Something struck my horn. It hurts.
I lower my head and recover.
My glow has weakened.
The grass no longer glows at my hooves.
The wound's on my horn. I can still walk.
Just slower.
I'm going. Stop following.

lines.zh: 这种苔草发光，我喜欢吃。
lines.en: This moss-grass glows, and I like it.
I lower my head and chew slowly.
Faint taste. Not bad.
You're holding it up. I can reach.
I take it and pull.
I don't eat much.
That much is enough.
Any more? I look up at you.

lines.zh: 你举着草，我的鼻子够不到。
lines.en: You hold the grass high; my nose cannot reach.

lines.zh: 嚼草要慢，这是我的规矩。
lines.en: Chewing grass is slow work by my rule.
That grass in your hand. Fresh.

lines.zh: 你手里的嫩芽，我闻见了。
lines.en: I smell the young shoots in your hand.
No rush. I won't run.
I lower my head and sniff. Clean.
I'll take this first bite.
Your arm must be tired. Lower it.
My light smears through the mist.
I'm not strong, but not light either.
I take two steps back and settle.
Your hand touched my horns.
Those are hard.

lines.zh: 两只兽擦过，皮毛带着光。
lines.en: Two beasts brush past, fur aglow.
We've flattened the grass.
I lower my head and give way.
You're ahead. You go first.
I'll wait until you've passed.
This glow of mine is too conspicuous.
But you don't seem to mind.

lines.zh: 两只发光的兽，在雾里并排。
lines.en: Two glowing beasts walk side by side in the fog.

lines.zh: 两个人的光，雾散得快些。
lines.en: Two lights thin the fog faster.
Walk on my right.
Take the right. Less fog there.
I'm slow. You'll have to wait.
I don't mind you waiting.
There's a meadow ahead.
We'll rest there.
I lower my head and touch it.
My light picks it out.
I lift it and put it back.
These mushrooms are poison; I leave them.

lines.zh: 这块石头压住了我要吃的草。
lines.en: This stone pins the grass I want.

lines.zh: 我蹄下的灰，会微微发亮。
lines.en: The ash under my hooves glows faintly.
It reflects light. Bright.

lines.zh: 我低下头，才看清是块骨头。
lines.en: I lower my head and see it is a bone.
Picked it up, looked, walked off.
I won't. You pick it up.
The little light on me is borrowed.
I raise my head and the light rises with it.
That patch in the fog went darker.

lines.zh: 我的角转向你，光跟着动。
lines.en: My horn turns toward you; its light follows.
My horns point that way.
Standing is enough. I needn't run.
Standing here, it can see me.
It hasn't come closer.
Grass first; I will look at you after.
Eating, and watching.
That direction — I keep an eye on it.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的影子，慢慢低下头。
lines.en: I watch its shadow and slowly lower my head.
The fog thins on my side.
Its side is still dark.

lines.zh: 我的角上那点光，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: The glow on my horn drifts closer.
The light goes with me.
It backs off a little.
That sets me at ease.
I don't need it near.
I only need it to stay away.
My horn tip pries its armor open.
I stamp a forehoof and ram again.
One more shove and the light scatters.

lines.zh: 我用角一顶，把它推出去。
lines.en: One horn thrust and I shove it away.
I raise a forehoof and bring it down.
The grass is pressed into the soil.

lines.zh: 我身上光一亮，它眼睛花了。
lines.en: My light flares and its eyes blur.
While it's blinded, I back off.
I only want to move on. I don't want to fight.
Don't come closer again.
A patch of fog lights up first.
A patch lights first. Then me.

lines.zh: 雾散了一点，我的蹄子落地。
lines.en: The fog thins, and my hooves touch ground.

lines.zh: 身上的光，把周围照亮一圈。
lines.en: My light makes a circle around me.
This ground is dark. I don't like it.
I lower my head and take a bite of grass.
Fog clears around my hooves.
Very quiet all around.
I walk, and the light follows.

lines.zh: 我朝那片暗处，慢慢走过去。
lines.en: I walk slowly toward that dark stretch.

lines.zh: 火一近，我的光就被压下去了。
lines.en: Fire neared and my light was smothered.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，光翻了一路。
lines.en: I rolled down the slope, light tumbling with me.

lines.zh: 水把我身上的光浇灭了。
lines.en: Water put out the glow on me.
The blast scattered my light.

lines.zh: 一根箭插在我发光的皮里。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my glowing hide.
That light is harder than mine.
Less grass, and my light thins.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我一亮，然后全暗了。
lines.en: Lightning struck. I flared, then went dark.
No grass here. No fog either.
